scripts.start: sh -lc 'if [ -z "$DATABASE_URL" ]; then if [ -n "$INTERNAL_DATABASE_URL" ]; then export DATABASE_URL="$INTERNAL_DATABASE_URL"; elif [ -n "$EXTERNAL_DATABASE_URL" ]; then export DATABASE_URL="$EXTERNAL_DATABASE_URL"; elif [ -n "$Internal_Database_URL" ]; then export DATABASE_URL="$Internal_Database_URL"; elif [ -n "$External_Database_URL" ]; then export DATABASE_URL="$External_Database_URL"; elif [ -n "$POSTGRES_URL" ]; then export DATABASE_URL="$POSTGRES_URL"; elif [ -n "$POSTGRESQL_URL" ]; then export DATABASE_URL="$POSTGRESQL_URL"; elif [ -n "$RENDER_POSTGRES_URL" ]; then export DATABASE_URL="$RENDER_POSTGRES_URL"; fi; fi; if [ -z "$DATABASE_URL" ] || ! echo "$DATABASE_URL" | grep -Eq "^(postgresql|postgres)://"; then echo "ERROR: DATABASE_URL must start with postgresql:// or postgres://" 1>&2; exit 1; fi; npm --workspace @unitedlinkgroup/database run db:push:deploy && npm --workspace api run start:prod'
